{{Quote|Batteries eight, ten, and twelve charging and acquiring targets. Ready to attack in twenty seconds.|Marfen|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Marfen''' was a [[Brubb]] weapons [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served [[Booster Terrik]] on his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', in [[44 ABY]]. When Terrik hosted the [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]], housing one hundred important [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], Marfen controlled the firing of the ''Errant Venture''{{'s}} weapons on their [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|Orbital Mirror]] targets. The firing on [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] property drew the attention of the [[Sixth Fleet|Galactic Alliance Sixth Fleet]]&mdash;allowing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to safely launch their [[StealthX]] wing to help [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|fight]] the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] without being attacked by the Alliance&mdash;but the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] could not retaliate with so many important politicians on board.
